application.description: MSG91 WhatsApp Business API integration for sending template messages, interactive messages, media attachments (images, documents, videos), managing templates, and receiving inbound messages. Supports buttons, lists, product catalogs, and rich media messaging.

auth_config.description: MSG91 authentication key from your account

services.description: Send WhatsApp message using pre-approved templates. Use this to initiate conversations with end users.

integrated_number.description: Your WhatsApp Business number with country code (e.g., 919999999999)

mobile_number.description: Recipient's mobile number with country code

language_code.description: Template language code (e.g., en, hi, es)

services.description: Send custom text message during an active WhatsApp session (24-hour window after user interaction)

integrated_number.description: Your WhatsApp Business number with country code

to_number.description: Recipient's mobile number with country code

message_text.description: Custom message text to send (session must be active)

services.description: Fetch all WhatsApp Business numbers linked to your MSG91 account
Get all existing WhatsApp templates linked to your integrated WhatsApp number

integrated_number.description: WhatsApp Business number to get templates for

services.description: Send interactive WhatsApp messages with up to 3 quick reply buttons

body_text.description: Main body text of the message

services.description: Send interactive WhatsApp messages with list selection options

body_text.description: Main body text of the message

services.description: Send a single product from your WhatsApp catalog
Send WhatsApp template messages in bulk to multiple recipients. Supports up to 1000 recipients per request with personalized variables for each recipient.

integrated_number.description: Your WhatsApp Business number with country code (e.g., 919999999999)

language_code.description: Template language code (e.g., en, hi, es)

to_and_components.description: Array of recipient objects with mobile numbers and personalized components

components.description: Array of component objects for this recipient

image.description: Image media object for image parameters

link.description: Public HTTPS URL to the image

document.description: Document media object for document parameters

link.description: Public HTTPS URL to the document

video.description: Video media object for video parameters

link.description: Public HTTPS URL to the video

services.description: Send WhatsApp template message with media attachment (image, document, video) in the header. Uses MSG91's simplified header_1 structure.

integrated_number.description: Your WhatsApp Business number with country code (e.g., 919999999999)

mobile_number.description: Recipient's mobile number with country code

template_name.description: Pre-approved template name from MSG91 that includes media header

language_code.description: Template language code (e.g., en, hi, es)

media_type.description: Type of media attachment (image, document, or video)

media_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the media file

services.description: Send media messages (image, document, video, audio) during active WhatsApp session (24-hour window after user interaction)

integrated_number.description: Your WhatsApp Business number with country code

to_number.description: Recipient's mobile number with country code

media_type.description: Type of media to send (image, document, video, or audio)

media_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the media file

caption.description: Optional caption for the media (not supported for audio)

services.description: Send document files with filename during active WhatsApp session. Supports PDF, DOC, XLS and other document formats.

integrated_number.description: Your WhatsApp Business number with country code

to_number.description: Recipient's mobile number with country code

document_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the document file

filename.description: Name of the file with extension (e.g., invoice.pdf)

services.description: Upload media file to MSG91 and get media ID for use in messages. Supports images, documents, videos and audio files.

file_data.description: Base64 encoded file data or file path

media_type.description: Type of media file being uploaded

events.description: Triggered when a WhatsApp message is received from a user. Configure this webhook in MSG91 Dashboard under WhatsApp > Webhook (New) > Create Webhook with event type 'On Inbound Report'.

webhook_setup_guide.step6: Select event type: 'On Inbound Report' or 'On Request Received'
webhook_setup_guide.step7: Enter callback URL: your IOFlow webhook endpoint

text.body: Hello, I need help with my order

events.description: Triggered when WhatsApp message delivery status changes (sent, delivered, read, failed). Configure this webhook in MSG91 Dashboard under WhatsApp > Webhook (New) with event type 'On Report Received'.
Triggered when a user clicks on an interactive button in a WhatsApp message. This is a subset of message_received event with specific handling for button interactions.
Triggered when a user selects an option from an interactive list in a WhatsApp message. This is a subset of message_received event with specific handling for list interactions.
Triggered when a user sends media content (image, document, video, audio) via WhatsApp. This is a subset of message_received event with specific handling for media messages.

media_id.description: Parameter extracted from $.image.id || document.id || video.id || audio.id

mime_type.description: Parameter extracted from $.image.mime_type || document.mime_type || video.mime_type || audio.mime_type

file_hash.description: Parameter extracted from $.image.sha256 || document.sha256 || video.sha256 || audio.sha256
